syllabus_topics: Introduction. Culture, ethics, and organizational structure.
assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) in the normal season is the sum of two T30 mini-tests (4.5 points each), the IST Management Challenge (2 points), and an exam (9 points). There are no minimum marks for the mini-tests or the normal season exam. In the recourse season, a 1.5-hour exam covers all material and accounts for 100% of the final grade. The better grade between the normal and recourse seasons counts. For special season and worker students, a single 1.5-hour exam covers all material and accounts for 100% of the final grade.
